source.title: MOLLIE Aspen | Boutique Hotel in Aspen | Official Site
source.description: Experience MOLLIE Aspen, where understated luxury meets a warm, residential ambiance in downtown Aspen, Colorado. Learn more about our boutique hotel.
source.content:
Welcome to
Mollie Aspen
Awarded One MICHELIN Key in 2026, MOLLIE is a boutique hotel inspired by the layered spirit of Aspen and the many individuals who shaped its vibrant history.
A place that honors the outdoors and encourages adventure while providing a luxurious experience to its guests. It is a place that believes in the beauty and freedom of simplicity and subtlety. Come here to connect, to get inspired, to find respite.
REST
RETREAT AND RESPITE
Considered and thoughtful design.
Our rooms evoke residential comfort through the subtle lens of Japanese and Scandinavian design. Removal of excess is the foundation of our interior, which creates spaces that evoke a feeling of calm and quiet where you can retreat and leave the burdens of the day behind.
TASTE
				SEASONAL AND 
TIMELESS					
						
Crafting a thoughtful, warm experience for visitors and locals alike.
MOLLIE Aspen offers a comprehensive range of dining options from morning to night. Indulge in delicious cuisine at Petit Trois, our lobby bar and restaurant, featuring indoor and year-round outdoor heated seating on two terraces. Our inviting cafe provides a casual dining experience for both breakfast and lunch. Relax and unwind by the hearth and savor a carefully crafted cocktail or kick start your morning with small batch coffee sourced from Sightglass.
EXPLORE
THE SOUL OF ASPEN IS VERY MUCH ALIVE
A dynamic, year-round destination.
MOLLIE is conveniently located within a short walk of downtown Aspen. Visit cultural hubs like The Aspen Institute, The Aspen Art Museum, or The Wheeler Opera House, shop Aspen’s walking malls, dine on the renowned restaurant row, revel in the vibrant nightlife, and more. All four ski areas are easily accessible from MOLLIE.
BOUTIQUE
CURATED FOR YOU
Our carefully curated boutique is designed for the discerning traveler, offering a selection of exceptional goods. Discover thoughtfully chosen accessories and objects that bring the essence of MOLLIE into your everyday life—whether you’re at home or on the go. Shop now and take a piece of MOLLIE with you, wherever your journey leads.
